speaker: voicedata-candidate-b
prosody_source: Voice B training-set mean of foundation-normalized prosody features

serving.strategy: deterministic standard seed; best-of-8 remains evaluation-only
serving.selection_score: speaker_similarity - 1.0 * cer - 0.05 * F0-envelope penalty - 0.05 * timbre penalty

reference_conditioning_rejected.reason: reference prefix conditioning raises speaker similarity but destroys intelligibility (CER 0.42-0.46 vs 0.076 unconditioned); the paired-reference full fine-tune did not learn to use a prefix reference for in-domain continuation at inference

notes: Context-full v1 full-backbone fine-tune (6000 updates, WavLM speaker-consistency training loss, 20% foundation replay) evaluated at 16 Euler steps, 120-prompt suite. Unconditioned: sim mean 0.9393 (+0.013 vs v7), sim p10 0.8918 (-0.012 vs v7), CER 0.0761 (3.2x worse than v7), WER 0.1773. Prefix-reference anchoring increases identity further but is intelligibility-fatal and is rejected. Net: not a promotion candidate; the v7 adapter recipe remains production. The speaker-consistency training objective alone did not converge identity beyond the adapter result on this data volume.
